messages:
Harper N: quick sync: we need a deprecation flow that doesn't scare tenants when they see estimated billing spikes. goal: clear sampling, smoothing of previews, and console copy that explains uncertainty.
Diego R: two immediate asks: 1) sampling semantics (how we pick requests for preview/shadow) and 2) how preview cost is presented (smoothed vs raw).
Leah M: sampling: propose stratified sampling by route_id + hour-of-day + top prompt-hash. this avoids bias from bursty traffic. default sample rates: 0.5% for small tenants, 0.1% for big ones, configurable.
Omar S: implementation detail: add `deprecation.sample_seed` to route config so preview runs are reproducible. also store sample metadata only (no full outputs) unless tenant opts in.
Harper N: smoothing: do not show raw single-run estimates. compute bootstrap CI over N resamples and display median + 90% CI. also show a small "variance" bar so owners know how noisy the estimate is.
Diego R: UX: banner copy should say: "Estimated cost impact: $X (median), 90% CI [$A, $B]. This estimate is based on a sampled simulation — results may vary." link to docs. keep it non-alarming.
Leah M: telemetry names: `deprec.preview.sampled_tokens`, `deprec.preview.estimate_usd_median`, `deprec.preview.estimate_usd_p10`, `deprec.preview.estimate_usd_p90`, `deprec.rollout.live_tokens`. tag keys: route_id, tenant_id, sample_seed.
Omar S: quotas: previews never consume hard quotas. however, when a tenant flips to staged/live we respect their quota and billing immediately. show a preview_quota_estimate metric (tokens/day) for planning.
Harper N: console controls: on route page add "Estimate cost" with slider for sample rate and a checkbox "Smooth estimates (bootstrap)". default ON. also show an "explain" link that describes methodology in plain language.
Diego R: alerting: if live rollout causes sustained billing_delta > 30% for 1h, or latency p95 +50ms for 15m, auto-pause and notify owner + ops. pager-bot will open incident as configured.
Leah M: logs/traces: tag every preview/shadowed request with `deprecation_cohort: preview|shadow|live` and `sample_seed` so we can correlate traces to estimate variance. record one sampled full-output per 10k requests for debugging (redacted).
Omar S: developer API: POST /routes/{id}/deprecation/preview {sample_rate, smooth=true} returns job_id and `estimate` when complete. store results in `deprec_preview_runs` table for 30 days. tenant can delete earlier.
Harper N: privacy: default is to redact outputs. tenants must enable "store samples" to keep raw outputs. include a privacy checkbox in modal.
Diego R: runbook snippet:```
IF alert(deprec.billing_delta > 30% for 1h):
  pause_rollout(route_id)
  notify(owner, ops)
  run quick-preview at 5x sample rate
  if regression persists: revert to prior pinned version
```
Leah M: action items: Omar -> API + sample_seed impl, Diego -> alert rules + CI display, Harper -> console copy & docs, I'll freeze metric names and open RFC. target feature-flagged alpha in 3 weeks.
console-bot: NOTE: enabling a preview creates a temporary dashboard and emits audit event `route.deprecation.preview.started`.
pager-bot: ALERT: auto-pause thresholds are live in staging behind flag `deprec-auto-pause`.
Harper N: thanks all 
 I'll open tickets and link RFC here. end.
